warnings: Steel gable roof, ridge on A''''' (2.00), with lower end skirts from grid 1 to 1' and grid 4 to 4' (A-03 roof plan hatching). Members from the ***หมายเหตุ*** legend: T1 = dash-dot line (grids 1-4, A' to B'), T2 = long-dash line (ridge, grid 1 to 4), แป = short dashes (C-75x45x15x2.3, spacing per roofing product), จันทัน = solid line (C-100x50x20x3.2 @1.00 m.). Roofing หลังคามุงเมทัลชีท (finish, not recorded).

T1 is split at the supports A and B; its 1.00 overhangs to A'/B' are their own segments (top chord only — the TRUSS T1 elevation draws only the top chord past the end posts). T2 is split at the T1 lines (grids 2 and 3).

อะเส (2C-150x50x20x2.3, ระดับหลังอะเส +4.70) is not drawn as its own line on this plan; it is placed on rows A and B from the TRUSS T1 elevation (it sits under both T1 ends) and the TRUSS T2 elevation / section A (continuous over the columns on grids 1-4). Flagged position_from_sections_not_drawn_on_plan, confidence 0.80.

End skirts: solid x-direction stubs from 1' to 1 (and 4 to 4') at rows A, A'', A''''', A'''''''' and B are read as jack rafters (legend: solid = จันทัน); their y positions coincide with the T1 panel points (1.00 x 4). The four corner diagonals (1'A'-A1, 4'A'-A4, B1-1'B', B4-4'B') are hip lines — diagonal, span left unresolved.

The six main rafter lines are counted, not positioned: they are not dimensioned individually, and the 2.50 bay draws them at ≈0.83 (three equal spaces) although the legend prints @1.00 m. Recorded as one counted element; no dummy grid lines invented for them.
Rafters and อะเส carry no mark: element_id null with element_name_assigned (section 0.2). C-section keys follow the house-95/134 mapping (d, b, lip, t).
